items.title: Is International Flavors & Fragrances (IFF) Cheap Or Fairly Priced Now?
items.summary: International Flavors & Fragrances has climbed this year, yet its longer term record and recent headlines leave a simple question hanging for investors. Is the current share price really in step with the cash flows the business can produce over time. items.title: Perfume bosses ran cartel at ‘beer and curry’ meetings
items.summary: The bosses of some of the world’s biggest perfume makers colluded to fix prices during “beer and curry” meetings in London, the UK’s competition watchdog has said.
